sentences.text: One more thing comes with the license: drug and alcohol rules that are stricter than for any recreational boater.
As a commercial operator, you must be enrolled in a Department of Transportation drug testing program.
Most owner-operators join a consortium that handles it.
The tests come before employment, at random, after a serious marine incident, and when there’s reasonable cause.
For alcohol, a commercial operator is intoxicated at zero point zero four percent.
After a serious marine incident, the clock starts.
Alcohol testing within two hours, drug testing within thirty-two hours.
And refusing a test can cost you your license.
Six passengers, uninspected vessel, five years.
